C09-M01-L01-F1.title: The forensic process, with analysis looping back to examination
C09-M01-L01-F1.caption: Six dependent stages from identification to presentation; analysis returns to examination whenever the evidence does not yet separate the hypotheses.
C09-M01-L01-F1.alt: Left-to-right flow of six boxes: Identify, Preserve, Collect, Examine, Analyse, Present, each with a short sub-label. A labelled loop runs from Analyse back to Examine: new question, extract more.

C09-M01-L01-F2.title: The integrity model: four layers, each checked against the one above
C09-M01-L01-F2.caption: The original stays sealed, the image is the fixed reference, examination happens on working copies, and every finding cites the copy it came from.
C09-M01-L01-F2.alt: Four stacked layers joined by downward arrows. Original evidence: sealed, under custody, handled as little as possible. Forensic image: bit-for-bit copy, hash equals the source hash recorded at acquisition. Working copy: the only layer examined, hash equals the image hash. Findings: each cites the working copy and the artefact it came from.
